comment: Pinned building-enrichment source metadata (DATA package). Pins are verified at fetch time (SHA-256). Overture releases are kept for only ~2 months by Overture; update 'overture.release' and re-pin when a fetch reports 404/410.

cache.comment: geo_q is the outward grid step used to expand the requested bbox into the per-geography cache key (~220 m at Kyiv latitude).

microsoft.height_note: Every height in GlobalMLBuildingFootprints is a machine-learning estimate for points/centroids; -1 marks unknown. None is emitted for unknown/non-finite/non-positive heights. Do NOT treat these heights as measured.
microsoft.geometry_note: Footprints are worldwide ML extractions; validation keeps only valid finite Polygon/MultiPolygon features intersecting the bbox.

overture.retention_note: Overture keeps only the two most recent monthly releases; this pin was verified reachable on 2026-09-20 (STAC latest). Re-pin on expiry.
overture.height_note: Overture 'height' mixes OSM tags and modeled estimates; treated as assumed, never claimed measured. Unknown/non-positive heights become None.
overture.duckdb_note: Optional bounded query via the duckdb CLI (isolated subprocess). Row-group predicate push-down on the bbox columns limits transferred DATA ROWS to intersecting row groups, but duckdb still reads parquet metadata (file/row-group/column stats) across world files, and its network byte volume is internal and NOT measured: audits report downloaded_bytes=None for this engine and extracted_bytes=size of the produced GeoJSON output. Timeout/thread/memory caps: duckdb_timeout=1800, SET threads=2, PRAGMA memory_limit='2GB'. Requires a duckdb binary (config 'duckdb_cli', env DUCKDB_CLI, PATH, or the repo-local default below) and runtime network for extensions. Prefer a genuine local GeoJSON export ('local_geojson') when the CLI is unavailable.

duckdb_bootstrap.command: curl -fL <url> -o /tmp/duckdb.zip && unzip -o /tmp/duckdb.zip -d /tmp/duckdb-cli && mkdir -p .cache/building-deps && cp /tmp/duckdb-cli/duckdb .cache/building-deps/duckdb-cli && chmod +x .cache/building-deps/duckdb-cli && sha256sum .cache/building-deps/duckdb-cli  # must equal binary_sha256
duckdb_bootstrap.note: The binary is a tool, never committed; re-pin the SHA-256s above whenever the pinned version changes.
